transcript.text:
I'll walk you through creating an uppercase transform and a concatenation transform in SailPoint ISC, then validating the output via the identity profile preview endpoint before you assign either to a profile.

---

## 1. Get an access token

```bash
TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST "https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "grant_type": "client_credentials",
    "client_id": "{client_id}",
    "client_secret": "{client_secret}"
  }' | jq -r '.access_token')
```

---

## 2. Create an uppercase transform

This reads `givenName` from the source account and uppercases it.

```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/transforms" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Upper Case First Name",
    "type": "upper",
    "attributes": {
      "input": {
        "type": "accountAttribute",
        "attributes": {
          "attributeName": "givenName",
          "sourceName": "Active Directory"
        }
      }
    }
  }' | tee /tmp/upper_transform.json
```

Save the returned `id` (call it `UPPER_ID`).

---

## 3. Create a concatenation transform

This joins `givenName` and `sn` with a space to produce a display name.

```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/transforms" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Display Name Concat",
    "type": "concat",
    "attributes": {
      "values": [
        {
          "type": "accountAttribute",
          "attributes": {
            "attributeName": "givenName",
            "sourceName": "Active Directory"
          }
        },
        {
          "type": "static",
          "attributes": { "value": " " }
        },
        {
          "type": "accountAttribute",
          "attributes": {
            "attributeName": "sn",
            "sourceName": "Active Directory"
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  }' | tee /tmp/concat_transform.json
```

---

## 4. Verify the saved definition

Before testing with live data, confirm the stored definition is what you expect:

```bash
UPPER_ID=$(jq -r '.id' /tmp/upper_transform.json)

curl -s "https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/transforms/$UPPER_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | jq .
```

---

## 5. Test against a real identity — profile preview

The transform-in-isolation tester is the identity profile preview endpoint. It accepts an inline `transformDefinition` so the transform **does not need to be wired into the profile yet** — you pass the definition directly in the body alongside a specific identity to evaluate against.

```bash
PROFILE_ID="{your-identity-profile-id}"
IDENTITY_ID="{identity-id-to-test-against}"

curl -s -X POST \
  "https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/identity-profiles/$PROFILE_ID/preview" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "identityId": "'"$IDENTITY_ID"'",
    "identityAttributeConfig": {
      "enabled": true,
      "attributeTransforms": [
        {
          "identityAttributeName": "firstname",
          "transformDefinition": {
            "type": "upper",
            "attributes": {
              "input": {
                "type": "accountAttribute",
                "attributes": {
                  "attributeName": "givenName",
                  "sourceName": "Active Directory"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  }' | jq '.previewAttributes[] | select(.name == "firstname")'
```

The response includes `previewAttributes` — check the `value` field for `firstname` to confirm the uppercase output is what you expect.

Once validated, you can reference the transform by name in the identity profile's attribute mapping using its saved `id` or name.

---

```answer-summary
endpoints:
  - method: POST
    path: /oauth/token
    api_version: oauth
  - method: POST
    path: /v3/transforms
    api_version: v3
  - method: GET
    path: /v3/transforms/{id}
    api_version: v3
  - method: POST
    path: /v3/identity-profiles/{identityProfileId}/preview
    api_version: v3
auth_flow: OAuth2 client credentials bearer token
required_scopes:
  - idn:transforms:manage
  - idn:transforms:read
  - idn:identity-profiles:read
key_parameters:
  - name
  - type
  - attributes
  - identityId
  - identityAttributeConfig
  - attributeTransforms
  - transformDefinition
```
